sourceTitle: Expanding Teen Account Protections to Teens Around the World
originalTitle: Expanding Teen Account Protections to Teens Around the World
author: heathera

blocks.text: For more than a decade, we’ve worked with leading experts to build tools and resources to help teens and families have age-appropriate and positive experiences on our apps. Teen Accounts on Instagram, Facebook, and Messenger provide teens with a set of built-in protections that automatically limit who can contact them, the content they see, and their time on our apps.
blocks.zh: 十多年来,帮助青少年与家庭在应用上拥有适龄且积极的经验。青少年账户在Instagram,脸书,和使者为青少年提供一套内置保护,自动限制谁可以与他们联系,他们所见所闻,和他们的时间 在我们的应用程序。
blocks.en: For more than a decade, we’ve worked with leading experts to build tools and resources to help teens and families have age-appropriate and positive experiences on our apps. Teen Accounts on Instagram, Facebook, and Messenger provide teens with a set of built-in protections that automatically limit who can contact them, the content they see, and their time on our apps.

blocks.text: Ensuring all teens receive these protections depends on knowing their age. This continues to be an industry-wide challenge as some teens may misrepresent their age online to access experiences they’re not old enough to use. We use AI technology to find people we suspect to be teens, even if they use an adult birthday, and place them in Teen Account protections. Since first introducing this technology, we’ve been placing more teens in age-appropriate protections and are encouraged by the results. Based on that success, today we’re expanding this technology globally.
blocks.zh: 确保所有青少年都得到这些保护取决于了解他们的年龄。这仍是整个行业的挑战, 因为有些青少年可能在网上不实年龄,我们利用人工智能技术 找到我们怀疑是十几岁的人即使他们用成人生日,把它们放进少年账户的保护中自从首次引进这种技术以来,我们一直在为更多青少年提供适合年龄的保护,基于这一成功,今天,我们在全球推广这种技术。
blocks.en: Ensuring all teens receive these protections depends on knowing their age. This continues to be an industry-wide challenge as some teens may misrepresent their age online to access experiences they’re not old enough to use. We use AI technology to find people we suspect to be teens, even if they use an adult birthday, and place them in Teen Account protections. Since first introducing this technology, we’ve been placing more teens in age-appropriate protections and are encouraged by the results. Based on that success, today we’re expanding this technology globally.

blocks.text: As a result, millions more teens across the world who use Instagram will receive these built-in protections, even if they’ve misrepresented their age. For parents, this means greater peace of mind: no matter where you live, we’re making proactive efforts to place your teen into age-appropriate protections — even if they use an adult birthday to set up an account. We’re continuing to roll this technology out on Facebook and, later this year, we’ll begin launching similar technology globally on Threads. This expansion builds on our commitments under our recent agreement with 52 bipartisan attorneys general to strengthen how we identify teens and children under 13 on our apps.
blocks.zh: 结果,全世界还有数百万使用Instagram的青少年将接受这些内置保护,即使他们虚报年龄,对于父母来说,这意味着实现更大的心灵平和:无论你住在哪里,即使他们用成人生日来开户, 我们仍积极努力为青少年提供适龄的保护。我们继续在Facebook上推出这项技术,今年晚些时候,我们开始在全球推广类似技术,这一扩大是基于我们根据最近与52名两党总检察长达成的协议所作的承诺,即加强我们如何在我们的应用程序上识别青少年和13岁以下儿童。
blocks.en: As a result, millions more teens across the world who use Instagram will receive these built-in protections, even if they’ve misrepresented their age. For parents, this means greater peace of mind: no matter where you live, we’re making proactive efforts to place your teen into age-appropriate protections — even if they use an adult birthday to set up an account. We’re continuing to roll this technology out on Facebook and, later this year, we’ll begin launching similar technology globally on Threads. This expansion builds on our commitments under our recent agreement with 52 bipartisan attorneys general to strengthen how we identify teens and children under 13 on our apps.

blocks.zh: 我们与父母的持续伙伴关系

blocks.text: This month, parents in the United States will begin to see an in-feed video on Instagram explaining our approach to ensuring their teens are in age-appropriate protections. The video will link to an article, written by Larry Magid, internet safety advocate and President and CEO of ConnectSafely, detailing our multi-layered age assurance approach, which includes keeping children under 13 off our platforms, providing age appropriate experiences for teens, and informing parents about ways they can partner with us to ensure their teens provide the correct age online. The article is available for all parents worldwide to read.
blocks.zh: 这个月美国的家长们将开始看到Instagram上的一则素材视频, 解释我们如何确保青少年得到适龄的保护。该视频将链接到一篇文章,由拉里·马吉德所写,互联网安全倡导者兼ConnectSafely总裁兼首席执行官,详细介绍了我们多层次的年龄保障方法,包括不让13岁以下儿童进入我们的平台,为青少年提供适龄体验;并告知父母他们可以和我们合作的方式,以确保他们的青少年在网上提供正确的年龄。这篇文章可供全世界所有父母阅读。
blocks.en: This month, parents in the United States will begin to see an in-feed video on Instagram explaining our approach to ensuring their teens are in age-appropriate protections. The video will link to an article, written by Larry Magid, internet safety advocate and President and CEO of ConnectSafely, detailing our multi-layered age assurance approach, which includes keeping children under 13 off our platforms, providing age appropriate experiences for teens, and informing parents about ways they can partner with us to ensure their teens provide the correct age online. The article is available for all parents worldwide to read.

blocks.zh: 使用 Apple 的年龄范围信号

blocks.text: In Australia, we’ve begun using Apple’s age-range signal as another method to help understand age. The process is simple. When a parent sets up a smartphone for their teen, they have the option for the app store to confirm the age of the person using the device and assign them an age range. Then, each time the teen downloads an app, Apple passes that age range to the developer — Meta, for example — confirming whether the teen meets the app’s age requirement.
blocks.zh: 在澳大利亚,我们开始使用苹果公司年龄范围信号作为帮助理解年龄的另一种方法。这一过程很简单。当父母为十几岁的孩子设置智能手机时,他们可以选择应用商店确认使用设备的人的年龄,并给他们分配一个年龄范围。接下来每次青少年下载一个应用程序,苹果将这个年龄范围传给了开发商——Meta,.例如,确认青少年是否符合应用程序的年龄要求。
blocks.en: In Australia, we’ve begun using Apple’s age-range signal as another method to help understand age. The process is simple. When a parent sets up a smartphone for their teen, they have the option for the app store to confirm the age of the person using the device and assign them an age range. Then, each time the teen downloads an app, Apple passes that age range to the developer — Meta, for example — confirming whether the teen meets the app’s age requirement.

blocks.text: We’re voluntarily using this signal, but as long as collecting it and sharing it remains optional for app stores, and using it remains optional for developers, teens will receive inconsistent protections across the many apps they use. We’ve long supported legislation requiring age verification and obtaining parental consent on the app store. One verified signal from people’s devices, shared consistently with all apps, is far more effective and privacy-preserving than asking every platform to verify age individually. And the work developers like Meta do to estimate age can be used as a backstop to help correct mistakes and feed them back to the app store for correction across all the apps a teen uses.
blocks.zh: 我们自愿使用这个信号,但只要收集并分享 仍然是应用程序商店的可选的,并且开发者仍然可以选择使用它,青少年在他们使用的许多应用程序中将获得不一致的保护。我们早就支持立法要求年龄核实,一个经过验证的信号 从人们的装置,与所有应用软件一致共享,比要求每个平台逐个核实年龄要有效得多,更能保护隐私。而Meta这样的工作开发者在估计年龄时可以被用作支持站,帮助纠正错误并反馈到应用程序商店,以在所有应用程序中更正 a青少年使用。
blocks.en: We’re voluntarily using this signal, but as long as collecting it and sharing it remains optional for app stores, and using it remains optional for developers, teens will receive inconsistent protections across the many apps they use. We’ve long supported legislation requiring age verification and obtaining parental consent on the app store. One verified signal from people’s devices, shared consistently with all apps, is far more effective and privacy-preserving than asking every platform to verify age individually. And the work developers like Meta do to estimate age can be used as a backstop to help correct mistakes and feed them back to the app store for correction across all the apps a teen uses.

blocks.text: Our Work on Age Assurance Continues
blocks.zh: 我们的年龄保障工作仍在继续
blocks.en: Our Work on Age Assurance Continues

blocks.text: Over the years, countries around the world have rapidly introduced new laws governing how to keep teens safe online. While well-intentioned, many of these laws don’t explain how technology companies should determine a user’s age. Some require invasive age checks for everyone, while others offer no guidance at all — leaving companies to figure out how to understand age without unnecessarily collecting sensitive data, like government IDs. We’ve set a strong standard for age assurance, but unless other companies follow suit, teens remain inconsistently protected online, defeating the purpose of these laws.
blocks.zh: 多年来,世界各国迅速出台新的法律,规范如何维护青少年的网络安全。虽然心意良好,科技公司应该如何决定用户年龄。有的要求对每个人进行入侵年龄检查,而另一些公司则完全不提供指导——让公司在不无必要地收集敏感数据的情况下,找出了解年龄的方法,像政府身份证。我们为年龄保障制定了严格的标准,除非其他公司也这样做,青少年在网络上仍然得不到一致的保护,击败了这些法律的目的。
blocks.en: Over the years, countries around the world have rapidly introduced new laws governing how to keep teens safe online. While well-intentioned, many of these laws don’t explain how technology companies should determine a user’s age. Some require invasive age checks for everyone, while others offer no guidance at all — leaving companies to figure out how to understand age without unnecessarily collecting sensitive data, like government IDs. We’ve set a strong standard for age assurance, but unless other companies follow suit, teens remain inconsistently protected online, defeating the purpose of these laws.

blocks.text: We’ll continue to do our part to proactively ensure teens are in age-appropriate experiences on our apps. That’s why as part of our agreement with 52 bipartisan attorneys general across US states, territories, and the District of Columbia, we’re investing in even stronger technology to proactively catch accounts that may belong to children under 13. We’re also strengthening the technology we use to identify accounts that may belong to teens between the ages of 13 and 17 so we can ensure those accounts are placed in experiences designed for teens, even if they give us an adult birthday. As Instagram is just one of the many apps teens use, we’re also calling on our industry peers, TikTok and YouTube, to adopt these same practices to keep teens safe.
blocks.zh: 我们将继续尽自己的力量, 积极确保青少年在应用软件上拥有适合年龄的经验。因此,作为我们与美国各州52名两党律师的协议的一部分,领土,和哥伦比亚特区,我们正投资更强大的技术, 主动抓住可能属于13岁以下儿童的账户。我们还在加强我们用来识别可能属于13至17岁青少年的账户的技术,以确保这些账户被放入其中。为青少年设计的经验,即使他们给我们一个成人生日。由于Instagram只是许多青少年使用的应用程序之一,我们也呼吁我们的行业同行,TikTok 和 YouTube, 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-21.采取同样的做法来保障青少年的安全。
blocks.en: We’ll continue to do our part to proactively ensure teens are in age-appropriate experiences on our apps. That’s why as part of our agreement with 52 bipartisan attorneys general across US states, territories, and the District of Columbia, we’re investing in even stronger technology to proactively catch accounts that may belong to children under 13. We’re also strengthening the technology we use to identify accounts that may belong to teens between the ages of 13 and 17 so we can ensure those accounts are placed in experiences designed for teens, even if they give us an adult birthday. As Instagram is just one of the many apps teens use, we’re also calling on our industry peers, TikTok and YouTube, to adopt these same practices to keep teens safe.
